source.excerpt: It is easy. You just chip away the stone that doesn't look like David
trail: Quote Investigator found no substantive evidence that Michelangelo made this remark. Its investigation traces an evolving sculptor joke through nineteenth-century examples, with Michelangelo-and-David versions appearing much later. Source and attribution evidence ↗

An 1858 discussion describes sculpting without the later joke; a humorous version was circulating by 1879. These are stages in the anecdote, not a transcript of Michelangelo speaking. Read the supporting source ↗
